_doc: Box mirror of the Mac mini desk feeds (quotes/mirror_poller.py; MINI-MIGRATION-PLAN.md). Group modes: off | shadow (writes market-data/shadow/<path>, never touches live files) | live (writes the real path or the catalog live_target). Flip/rollback groups ONLY with scripts/oid-cutover.sh (it also stops/restarts the box daemon that used to own the group). The poller never runs unless started (scripts/mirror-poller.sh start, or touch cache/mirror-poller.enabled so the mini-link watchdog keeps it up). Kill switch: touch cache/mirror.disabled.
